biggest_catch: The direct deposit must be NEW to UCCU (payroll, pension, or government benefits totaling $1,000+ within 65 days of the first direct deposit) — P2P transfers (Venmo, PayPal, Apple Pay) do not count, and UCCU claws back the bonus if you close the account within six months of receiving it.
catches: Limited-time offer: available only at the UCCU Riverton branch or online with promo code GO26RV.
Direct deposit must be new to UCCU and at least $500 per month — peer-to-peer deposits (Venmo, PayPal, Apple Pay, etc.) do NOT qualify.
Bonus is paid only after the second qualifying direct deposit from payroll, pension, or government benefits totaling $1,000 or more within 65 days of the first direct deposit posting.
If you close the account within six months of receiving the incentive, UCCU may debit the $300 back from the account.
Bonus may take 10-30 business days to be awarded and may be reported as interest income on IRS Form 1099-INT (taxable).
Limited-time offer, subject to change at any time without notice; no explicit end date is published on the official page.
UCCU membership required — Utah-based community field of membership; standard membership/share deposit applies.

steps: Join UCCU and open a new checking account online at uccu.com or at a branch.
Set up a qualifying direct deposit that is NEW to UCCU — payroll, pension, or government benefits of at least $500 per month (peer-to-peer transfers like Venmo/PayPal/Apple Pay do not count).
Receive at least two direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more within 65 days of the first direct deposit posting.
The $300 bonus is awarded 10-30 business days after qualifying; keep the account open at least six months to avoid a clawback.
timing: Bonus awarded 10-30 business days after qualifying direct deposits are funded.
